name: Serbia
summary: Possessing any controlled drug, even a small amount for own use, is a crime (fine or up to 3 yrs; court may waive the penalty). Large amounts: 3–10 yrs. The control list is broad and was updated in 2023–24.

poisonControl.name: National Poison Control Centre, Military Medical Academy (VMA), Belgrade (24h)

callingForHelp: No Good Samaritan law or other specific legal protection for people who call an ambulance (194) for an overdose was found.

cc.title: Criminal Code (Krivični zakonik), arts. 246–247, consolidated to Sl. glasnik 63/2026

list.title: Customs Administration – list of psychoactive controlled substances per Pravilnik (Sl. glasnik 77/2024), Feb 2025

lsd.note: LSD (and 1P-LSD, 1cP-LSD, 1B-LSD) are listed. Own-use possession: fine or up to 3 yrs (art. 246a).

mushrooms.note: Psilocybin and psilocin are listed; mushrooms/truffles containing them are treated as drugs under art. 246a.

dmt.note: DMT is listed (ayahuasca contains DMT). Possession for own use: fine or up to 3 yrs, court may waive penalty; large amounts 3–10 yrs (CC art. 246a).

mescaline.note: Mescaline is listed; the status of live cacti (peyote, San Pedro) was not specifically confirmed.

dox.note: DOM (STP) and DOB are on the national list. Possession for own use: fine or up to 3 yrs, court may waive penalty; large amounts 3–10 yrs (CC art. 246a).

nbomes.note: 25I-, 25B- and 25C-NBOMe are on the national list. Possession for own use: fine or up to 3 yrs, court may waive penalty; large amounts 3–10 yrs (CC art. 246a).

2c-x.note: 2C-B and several 2C-B derivatives are listed. Possession for own use: fine or up to 3 yrs, court may waive penalty; large amounts 3–10 yrs (CC art. 246a).

2c-t-x.note: 2C-T-2, 2C-T-4, 2C-T-7 and 2C-T-21 are on the national list (not UN-controlled, but controlled in Serbia).

5-meo-xxt.note: 5-MeO-DMT, 5-MeO-DIPT and 5-MeO-MIPT are on the national list.

cannabis.note: Own-use possession: fine or up to 3 yrs (may be waived); large amounts 3–10 yrs; cultivation 2–8 yrs. No medical cannabis access.

ketamine.note: Controlled (on the national list); used as an anaesthetic. Possession without authorisation is prosecuted like other drugs.

mxe.note: Methoxetamine is on the national list (UN Schedule II). Own-use possession: fine or up to 3 yrs (art. 246a).

dxm.note: Not controlled: the list explicitly excludes dextromethorphan from control. Only medicines rules apply.

nitrous.note: Nitrous oxide is not on the controlled-substance list; no possession offence found.

amphetamines.note: Amphetamine, dexamfetamine and methamphetamine are listed; possession without a prescription is a crime (art. 246a).

mdma.note: MDMA is listed. Possession for own use: fine or up to 3 yrs, court may waive penalty; large amounts 3–10 yrs (CC art. 246a).

cocaine.note: Cocaine is listed. Possession for own use: fine or up to 3 yrs, court may waive penalty; large amounts 3–10 yrs (CC art. 246a).

alcohol.note: Legal for adults; selling, serving or giving alcohol to under-18s is prohibited.

ghb/gbl.note: GHB is listed (own-use possession is a crime). GBL and 1,4-butanediol are not on the list.

opioids.note: Heroin, morphine, oxycodone, fentanyl and analogues are listed; prescription opioids are legal only with a prescription.

tramadol.note: Tramadol is on the controlled list; prescription-only.

benzodiazepines.note: Listed psychotropics (e.g. diazepam, alprazolam, clonazepam); prescription-only.

maois.note: MAOI antidepressants are prescription-only. Harmine is on the controlled list; ayahuasca contains DMT (controlled).
